text: For settlement totals, use the last row encountered for each merchant/invoice pair; incoming rows are expected in revision order.
When a void row follows a paid row, subtract the earlier paid amount from the merchant total.
The dashboard's compact mode uses 12 px labels and hides the secondary legend. This does not define settlement behavior.
For each merchant/invoice pair, choose the row with the highest numeric revision, regardless of input order. A duplicate highest revision for the same pair is invalid, even if its fields match.
After selecting the highest revision, a Void winner contributes nothing. Do not subtract an earlier Paid revision; earlier revisions are replaced.
Sum cents from Paid winners by merchant using checked signed 64-bit addition. Return one row per merchant with a nonzero total, sorted by merchant ID ascending. An empty input returns an empty list.
